about: Map presentation measurements (docs/research/map-presentation.md). Step MP.1: the MAPS §7.2 harness extended to the revision 3.1 mix at the caps (§25.7) with the moveend bookkeeping, at 1x and 4x CPU throttling, and the band crossing (§17.4). Step MP.2: the art-sampling contrast test's minima (§25.6).

mp1.browser: Chrome/153.0.8010.54 headless (new), no GPU (software raster), throwaway profile deleted
mp1.method: The real LeafletMapAdapter (smoothWheel on: the backing store at the device pixel ratio) in a 1280 x 800 stage at DPR 1.5, zone band (zoom -2), our own scratch page .cache/mp1/harness/main.ts driven by .cache/mp1/harness/run.mjs (CDP, Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 1 and 4). Mix A: 300 pins drawn from cached bitmaps through the path renderer (100 quest givers with the pip tag, 40 turn-ins, 30 dungeons, 35 flight points, 27 transport stops, 18 light services, 50 counted objectives; the MP.4a design drawn with src/map/marks.ts) and 1,720 other items (58 frames and 2 terrain paths, 100 flight lines, 150 route pieces of 64 vertices, 450 objective dots, 700 beads, 100 proposal lines, 100 selection items, 60 labels on the labels canvas with 150 step numbers). The moveend frame is the synchronous task of a 120 px pan (Leaflet's projection and redraw, the adapter's moveend, the stack merge by spatial hash over the pins); the labels canvas is drawn in the next frame and the hit index (a 32 px grid) off the frame, each timed on its own. Mix B adds 480 pins (2,500 items, the full cap). Fallback 1: objective dots 500 to 300 at the zone band; fallback 2: also pins 300 to 250 (§25.7). The crossing: a smooth-wheel settle (_moveEnd after six gesture frames) from the continent band (-3.8) to the zone band (-3.25) and back, with the band-dependent layers swapped in as the controller does (quest givers, objectives, flight lines, labels) and the adapter's cross-fade; setZoomBackTaskMs is a button or key zoom back with no content change. Frame intervals include headless software compositing of the 2304 x 1440 canvases and are an upper bound, not the app's GPU path (§25.7).

mp2ArtContrast.method: tests/map-art-contrast.test.ts: 400 pixels on a fixed grid from each of the 318 committed painted atlas tiles at level -2 (127,202 samples with the two sea colours) and from every 16th minimap tile at level 0 (300 tiles, 120,001 samples with the navy; the local tile pack, not committed, D-049 O14). Minimum contrast over the samples.
mp2ArtContrast.note: The design's figures (§25.6, from the probe's native samples): pin 4.09, minimap label 11.57, route 5.40, lines 3.88. The line figure here, 3.28 over the stitched level-0 tiles, is lower; every check passes its 3:1 or 4.5:1 need.

mp4a.browser: Chrome/153.0.8010.54 headless (new), no GPU (software raster), throwaway profile deleted; another process held one of the 16 logical processors throughout
mp4a.method: The real LeafletMapAdapter with the real pins (src/map/leaflet/pins.ts: bitmaps from the LRU cache, stacks by spatial hash at the zone and close bands, the hit index built off the frame) and the real layer builder (src/map/layers.ts), in a 1280 x 800 stage at DPR 1.5 (smoothWheel on), our own scratch page .cache/mp4/harness/main.ts driven by .cache/mp4/harness/run.mjs (CDP, Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 1 and 4, two page loads each, 40 pans of 120 px). Synthetic, deterministic content. Zone band (zoom -2): the builder's quest givers (100 drawn of 120 in view, one to three quests each, five difficulties, available, uncertain and locked), turn-ins (40, in progress) and flight masters (35, no route state), 50 counted objective pins beside 450 objective dots, and 30 dungeons, 27 transport stops and 18 services as descriptors (their builders arrive with later steps), plus MP.1's other items (58 frames, 2 terrain paths, 100 flight lines, 150 route pieces of 64 vertices, 700 beads, 100 proposal lines, 100 selection items, 60 labels): 2,020 items. zoneWithoutPinLayers: the same with every pin layer empty (the 300 pins and the 450 dots gone, 1,270 items). Continent band (zoom -4): 373 givers over the continent, clustered by the builder (the cells of the level the zoom picks), turn-ins, flight masters, dungeons and transports: 1,702 items. panTaskMs is the synchronous task of a pan (Leaflet's projection and redraw, the adapter's moveend; stacks are not recomputed on a pan); labelsNextFrameMs the labels canvas in the next frame; hitIndexIdleMs one build of the pins' hit index as the idle callback makes it; zoomSettleTaskMs a button zoom of half a level within the zone band with pinRefreshAtSettleMs the pins' refresh (sizes, mask, stacks) inside it; clustering the builder's first call for 373 givers (all four levels) and a call at another continent zoom (the memo's lookup); the crossing a button zoom from -4 to -3 with the content kept (the controller would rebuild the layers there; this is the adapter's settle with its pin refresh). Frame and task times include headless software compositing and are an upper bound, not the app's GPU path (map-presentation.md 25.7).

earlierSession.note: The same harness run 20 minutes earlier (without the no-pins variant): zone mix A pan task at 4x, median 18.8 and 18.2 ms (p90 22.3, 22.6); at 1x 3.8 and 4.6 ms. Clustering 373 givers at 4x: 11.9 and 8.1 ms median.

mp4a.gate: At 4x the zone mix A pan task is 18.2 to 19.7 ms median over both sessions, above the 16 ms line of 25.7, as MP.1 measured for its prototype (19.2 to 19.7 ms, and 17.3 to 19.4 ms with the fallbacks). Without the pin layers the same mix takes 12.8 to 14.4 ms: the 300 pins and 450 objective dots cost 5.3 to 6.3 ms of the task. Not applied here: the fallbacks are the architect's call (MP.1 found they do not reach 16 ms).

reviewFixHalos.about: Review findings PR-02 and PR-03 (the route after the active step dashed 5-6 at 55 % on its halo; HaloPolyline: the route 2.6 px over a 5.5 px halo, the flight network and rides 1.1 px over 3 px). Contrast on RENDERED pixels of the production build (headless Chrome, minimap style), each line pixel against its own halo edge and, for comparison, against the ground beside the line: .cache/map-ui-build/fix-presentation/contrast.mjs over the screenshots in .cache/map-ui-build/fix-presentation/after/ (pr03-*.png). These replace the token-pair halo figures of mp2ArtContrast for the halos as built; p5 is noisy where lines cross pins and joins.
reviewFixHalos.note: The finding PR-03 measured the route at 1.73:1 on bright ground without a halo; with the halo the line reads against its own edge. The dashed part after the active step is deliberately fainter (3.1:1 median on its halo). The windowed contrast theme (MP.12) was not checked (it needs a Windows setting changed); only Chrome’s emulated forced colours were.
